The '''G-12 repulsortaxi''' was a style of [[taxi speeder]] designed and produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]<ref name="AIR" /> during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|303|G-12 (2)}}</ref>
